title: Luxury Safari Experience
description: Embark on the ultimate luxury safari across Kenya's most iconic wildlife reserves. From the sweeping plains of the Maasai Mara to the elephant paradise of Amboseli with stunning views of Mount Kilimanjaro, this curated journey offers world-class game drives, exclusive lodge stays, and intimate encounters with the Big Five.
shortDescription: A 7-day luxury safari through Kenya's most iconic wildlife reserves.
highlights: Big Five game drives in the Maasai Mara
Sunrise hot air balloon over the savanna
included: Daily game drives with expert guides

itinerary.title: Arrival in Nairobi
itinerary.description: Welcome at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport. Transfer to a luxury hotel in Nairobi for overnight rest.

itinerary.title: Maasai Mara Reserve
itinerary.description: Fly to the Mara. Afternoon game drive. Full day of exploration with morning and evening drives.

itinerary.title: Balloon Safari
itinerary.description: Pre-dawn hot air balloon ride over the Mara followed by champagne breakfast in the bush.

itinerary.title: Amboseli National Park
itinerary.description: Transfer to Amboseli. Game drives with views of Kilimanjaro. Visit a Maasai village.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning game drive, then transfer to Nairobi for your departing flight.

title: Coastal Escape
description: Discover the pristine white sand beaches and turquoise waters of Kenya's Indian Ocean coast. This luxury coastal retreat takes you from the powdery shores of Diani Beach to the marine wonderland of Watamu, featuring exclusive beach villas, world-class snorkeling, and sunset dhow cruises.
shortDescription: A 5-day luxury beach retreat along Kenya's stunning Indian Ocean coast.
included: All meals, snacks, and house beverages at the resort
Snorkeling equipment and guided trip in Watamu Marine Park
Daily activities programme at the resort

itinerary.title: Arrival in Diani
itinerary.description: Transfer from Mombasa airport to your private beach villa. Welcome dinner.

itinerary.title: Diani Beach Day
itinerary.description: Full day of relaxation, water sports, and spa treatments.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Watamu
itinerary.description: Scenic coastal drive to Watamu. Afternoon snorkeling in the marine park.

itinerary.title: Marine Adventures
itinerary.description: Morning dolphin-watching boat trip. Sunset dhow cruise with dinner.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Leisurely morning before airport transfer.

title: Nairobi City & Culture
description: Experience the vibrant heart of East Africa with this curated city tour of Nairobi. From the emotional David Sheldrick Elephant Orphanage to the Karen Blixen Museum and bustling Maasai Market, discover why Nairobi is one of Africa's most exciting capitals.
shortDescription: A 3-day curated exploration of Nairobi's best cultural highlights.

itinerary.title: Nairobi Highlights
itinerary.description: Visit the Elephant Orphanage and Giraffe Centre. Afternoon at the Karen Blixen Museum.

itinerary.title: Wildlife & Markets
itinerary.description: Morning game drive in Nairobi National Park. Afternoon shopping at Maasai Market.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Leisure morning, optional brunch, then airport transfer.

title: Romantic Getaway
description: A bespoke romantic escape through Kenya's Great Rift Valley and the foothills of Mount Kenya. Stay in exclusive lakeside lodges at Lake Naivasha, enjoy private boat rides among hippos, and end with a starlit dinner at a luxury ranch in Nanyuki with views of Mount Kenya.
shortDescription: A 4-day romantic escape through Kenya's Rift Valley and Mount Kenya region.
highlights: Private boat ride on Lake Naivasha
Luxury lodge with Mount Kenya views
included: Private boat rides and walking safaris

itinerary.title: Lake Naivasha
itinerary.description: Drive from Nairobi through the Rift Valley. Check into lakeside lodge. Sunset boat ride.

itinerary.title: Crescent Island & Spa
itinerary.description: Walking safari on Crescent Island. Afternoon couples spa. Romantic dinner.

itinerary.title: Nanyuki
itinerary.description: Drive to Nanyuki. Check into Mount Kenya lodge. Private starlit bush dinner.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning nature walk. Transfer back to Nairobi.

title: Ultimate Kenya
description: The definitive Kenya experience. This comprehensive two-week journey takes you from the savannas of the Maasai Mara to the peaks of Mount Kenya, from the flamingo-filled lakes of the Rift Valley to the palm-fringed beaches of the coast. Every aspect of Kenya's extraordinary diversity in one unforgettable trip.
shortDescription: The ultimate 14-day journey across all of Kenya's most spectacular regions.
highlights: Big Five safari in Maasai Mara
included: Luxury safari lodge accommodation on the Mara, Lake Nakuru, Naivasha, and Mount Kenya legs (full board)
All meals and house beverages on the safari portion
All-inclusive boutique stay on Lamu and beach resort at Diani — meals, snacks, drinks, and resort activities included

itinerary.title: Nairobi
itinerary.description: City tour, Elephant Orphanage, and preparation for the journey ahead.

itinerary.title: Maasai Mara
itinerary.description: Three days of exceptional game drives and a hot air balloon safari.

itinerary.title: Lake Nakuru & Naivasha
itinerary.description: Flamingos, rhinos, and a private boat ride on Lake Naivasha.

itinerary.title: Mount Kenya
itinerary.description: Trekking in the foothills, luxury mountain lodge stay.

itinerary.title: Lamu Island
itinerary.description: Fly to Lamu. Explore the UNESCO World Heritage old town. Dhow sailing.

itinerary.title: Diani Beach
itinerary.description: Coastal relaxation, snorkeling, and spa treatments.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Final morning on the coast before transfer to Mombasa airport.

title: Northern Kenya Explorer
description: Venture into Kenya's untamed north, where arid landscapes meet extraordinary wildlife found nowhere else in the country. Samburu National Reserve is home to the rare Grevy's zebra, reticulated giraffe, and gerenuk, while the private conservancies of Laikipia offer exclusive encounters with endangered black rhinos and wild dogs in settings that feel entirely your own.
shortDescription: A 5-day luxury expedition through Samburu and the private conservancies of Laikipia.
highlights: Sundowner cocktails overlooking the Ewaso Ng'iro River
Cultural visit to a Samburu community
included: Luxury lodge and tented camp accommodation
Daily game drives with expert naturalists

itinerary.title: Fly to Samburu
itinerary.description: Morning flight from Nairobi's Wilson Airport. Afternoon game drive along the Ewaso Ng'iro River.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Samburu
itinerary.description: Morning and evening game drives searching for leopard, Grevy's zebra, and gerenuk. Cultural visit to a Samburu manyatta.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Laikipia
itinerary.description: Scenic drive to a private conservancy in Laikipia. Afternoon guided bush walk and sundowners.

itinerary.title: Conservancy Experience
itinerary.description: Black rhino tracking on foot with conservancy rangers. Night game drive to spot nocturnal species.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning nature walk, then fly back to Nairobi.

title: Fly-in Mara Safari
description: For travellers short on time but unwilling to compromise on experience, this exclusive fly-in safari delivers the very best of the Maasai Mara in three focused days. Skip the long road transfer and land directly on the plains. Every moment is spent where it matters: among the wildlife, with a world-class guide at your side.
shortDescription: A 3-day fly-in luxury safari for the full Maasai Mara experience without the long drive.
highlights: Direct flight to a private Mara airstrip
Morning and evening Big Five game drives
included: Return flights Nairobi to Masai Mara
Twice-daily game drives with a private guide

itinerary.title: Arrive in the Mara
itinerary.description: Morning flight from Wilson Airport. Arrive at your luxury tented camp. Afternoon game drive through the open savanna.

itinerary.title: Full Day of Game Drives
itinerary.description: Sunrise drive targeting big cats and the Great Migration (seasonal). Bush breakfast under an acacia tree. Evening drive and sundowners.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Early morning game drive or optional balloon ride. Fly back to Nairobi by midday.

title: Bush & Beach
description: The definitive two-in-one Kenya journey. Begin with world-class game drives in the Maasai Mara, traverse the vast red landscapes of Tsavo where elephants dust themselves in crimson earth, then unwind on the white sands of Diani Beach. This itinerary weaves together the very best of safari and coast in a single, seamless trip.
shortDescription: A 10-day journey from the Mara's savannas through Tsavo to the beaches of Diani.
highlights: Big Five game drives in the Maasai Mara
White sand beaches and turquoise waters at Diani
Sunset dhow cruise along the coast
included: Luxury safari lodge accommodation on the Mara and Tsavo legs
All meals and house beverages on the safari portion (full board)
All-inclusive beach resort accommodation at Diani — meals, snacks, drinks, and resort activities included
Daily game drives with expert guides

itinerary.title: Arrival in Nairobi
itinerary.description: Welcome at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport. Overnight in Nairobi.

itinerary.title: Maasai Mara
itinerary.description: Fly to the Mara for three days of game drives. Morning and evening drives targeting the Big Five.

itinerary.title: Tsavo West
itinerary.description: Drive south through the Great Rift Valley to Tsavo West. Visit Mzima Springs and spot the famed red elephants.

itinerary.title: Tsavo East
itinerary.description: Cross into Tsavo East. Game drive through the Yatta Plateau, the world's longest lava flow.

itinerary.title: Diani Beach
itinerary.description: Transfer to the coast. Two days of white sand, warm ocean, and total relaxation. Optional snorkeling or dhow cruise.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Leisurely morning before transfer to Mombasa airport.

title: Rift Valley Discovery
description: Explore the dramatic landscapes of Kenya's Great Rift Valley, where flamingo-lined lakes meet towering volcanic cliffs. This compact itinerary takes you from the rhino sanctuary of Lake Nakuru to the hippo-filled waters of Lake Naivasha and the striking gorges of Hells Gate, one of the few parks in Kenya where you can walk and cycle among wildlife.
shortDescription: A 4-day exploration of the Great Rift Valley's lakes, wildlife, and volcanic landscapes.
highlights: Flamingos and rhinos at Lake Nakuru
Walking or cycling through Hells Gate
Fischer's Tower and the gorge trail
included: Park entry fees and boat safari

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Lake Nakuru
itinerary.description: Morning drive through the escarpment to Lake Nakuru National Park. Afternoon game drive among flamingos, rhinos, and leopards.

itinerary.title: Lake Naivasha
itinerary.description: Drive to Lake Naivasha. Boat safari to spot hippos and fish eagles. Afternoon walking safari on Crescent Island.

itinerary.title: Hells Gate National Park
itinerary.description: Full day exploring Hells Gate on foot and by bicycle. Hike the volcanic gorge with its towering cliffs and hot springs.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure, then transfer back to Nairobi.

title: Great Migration Safari
description: Witness one of the natural world's greatest spectacles. Timed for peak migration season, this immersive five-day safari places you at the heart of the action as over a million wildebeest and zebra cross the Mara River. Staying in an exclusive private conservancy bordering the reserve ensures front-row access with fewer vehicles and more intimate encounters.
shortDescription: A 5-day safari timed for the Great Migration river crossings in the Maasai Mara.
highlights: Full-day game drives with picnic lunches
Night game drive in the conservancy
included: Luxury tented camp in a private conservancy
Unlimited game drives with a private guide

itinerary.title: Arrive in the Mara
itinerary.description: Morning flight to the Mara. Check into your luxury tented camp in the private conservancy. Afternoon game drive.

itinerary.title: Migration Tracking
itinerary.description: Full-day game drive following the migration herds. Picnic lunch on the plains. Evening drive and sundowners.

itinerary.title: River Crossing Watch
itinerary.description: Position at a prime Mara River crossing point. Watch for herds gathering to make the dramatic crossing. Predators often patrol the banks.

itinerary.title: Conservancy Exclusive
itinerary.description: Morning walking safari with a Maasai guide. Afternoon game drive. Night drive to spot hyenas, aardvarks, and bush babies.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Sunrise game drive. Fly back to Nairobi by midday.

title: Wilderness & Adventure
description: Ten days for travellers who want more than a traditional game drive. This active expedition combines a multi-day Mount Kenya trek, gorge hiking through Hells Gate, walking safaris in Laikipia's private conservancies, and a rainforest day in the Aberdares. Summit the lower peaks of Mount Kenya, cycle alongside zebras and giraffes, and track black rhinos on foot through some of Kenya's most dramatic high-country terrain.
shortDescription: A 10-day active expedition combining mountain trekking, gorge hikes, and walking safaris.
highlights: Mount Kenya trek to Point Lenana
Guided bush walks in Laikipia conservancies
Gorge hiking past volcanic hot springs
included: Mountain lodge and tented camp accommodation

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Mount Kenya
itinerary.description: Drive to the foothills of Mount Kenya. Check into a mountain lodge. Afternoon nature walk through the montane forest.

itinerary.title: Forest Acclimatisation
itinerary.description: Guided walk through the bamboo zone with a mountain naturalist. Equipment check and trek briefing in the afternoon.

itinerary.title: Trek to Old Moses Camp
itinerary.description: Begin the multi-day ascent. Hike through montane forest into the moorland zone. Overnight at Old Moses Camp.

itinerary.title: Trek to Shipton's Camp
itinerary.description: Cross the Mackinder Valley with views of the main peaks. Reach Shipton's Camp at 4,200m for acclimatisation overnight.

itinerary.title: Point Lenana Summit & Descent
itinerary.description: Pre-dawn summit attempt at Point Lenana (4,985m). Descend to the mountain lodge by afternoon for a celebratory dinner.

itinerary.title: Rest & Nature Walk
itinerary.description: A slower day at the lodge. Optional guided walks, spa treatments, or simply unwinding by the mountain views.

itinerary.title: Aberdares National Park
itinerary.description: Drive to the Aberdares for a rainforest day. Game drive in search of elephants, buffalo, and the elusive bongo.

itinerary.title: Hells Gate
itinerary.description: Drive to Hells Gate National Park. Cycle through the park among giraffes and zebras. Hike the volcanic gorge past hot springs.

itinerary.title: Laikipia Conservancy
itinerary.description: Transfer to a private conservancy in Laikipia. Walking safari with rangers, then visit Ol Pejeta rhino sanctuary.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning bush walk, then drive back to Nairobi.

title: Naivasha Weekend Escape
description: The perfect short break from Nairobi. Just ninety minutes from the city, Lake Naivasha offers hippo-filled boat rides, a walking safari on Crescent Island where giraffes and wildebeest roam freely, and some of the best birdwatching in the Rift Valley. Ideal for a Friday evening departure with a full Saturday of adventure and a relaxed Sunday return.
shortDescription: A 2-day weekend break with boat safaris and walking among wildlife on Crescent Island.
highlights: Boat safari among hippos and fish eagles
Lakeside lodge with Rift Valley views
included: Boat safari and Crescent Island entry

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Naivasha
itinerary.description: Depart Nairobi in the afternoon. Check into your lakeside lodge. Sunset boat ride on Lake Naivasha.

itinerary.title: Crescent Island & Return
itinerary.description: Morning walking safari on Crescent Island. Lunch at the lodge, then drive back to Nairobi.

title: Nakuru Weekend Safari
description: A compact weekend safari that puts you face to face with rhinos, flamingos, and leopards within hours of leaving Nairobi. Lake Nakuru National Park is one of the best places in Kenya to spot both black and white rhinos, and the Baboon Cliff viewpoint offers sweeping panoramas of the entire Rift Valley lake basin.
shortDescription: A 2-day weekend safari to Lake Nakuru for rhinos, flamingos, and Rift Valley views.
highlights: Leopard tracking in the acacia forest

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Nakuru
itinerary.description: Early morning departure. Arrive at Lake Nakuru National Park by mid-morning. Full day of game drives with a lunch break at the lodge.

itinerary.title: Morning Drive & Return
itinerary.description: Sunrise game drive to Baboon Cliff. Final drive through the park, then return to Nairobi by late afternoon.

title: Mt Kenya Weekend Retreat
description: Escape to the cool highlands at the foot of Africa's second-highest peak. This three-day retreat combines nature walks through montane forest, a visit to the Ol Pejeta Conservancy to see the last northern white rhinos, and the novelty of standing on the equator line. Stay in a luxury mountain lodge with views of the snow-capped peaks.
shortDescription: A 3-day highland retreat with conservancy visits and Mount Kenya views.
highlights: Ol Pejeta Conservancy and rhino sanctuary

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Nanyuki
itinerary.description: Morning drive through the central highlands. Stop at the equator line. Check into your mountain lodge. Afternoon nature walk.

itinerary.title: Ol Pejeta Conservancy
itinerary.description: Full day at Ol Pejeta. Game drive to see the Big Five, visit the chimpanzee sanctuary, and the northern white rhino enclosure.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning walk in the Mount Kenya forest. Return to Nairobi after lunch.

title: Safari Honeymoon
description: Begin married life surrounded by the wild beauty of Kenya. This honeymoon journey pairs the romance of a private Mara conservancy with the serenity of a lakeside retreat at Naivasha. Expect private game drives, a champagne bush dinner under the stars, a hot air balloon at sunrise, and a couples boat ride among hippos on the lake.
shortDescription: A 6-day safari honeymoon blending Mara wildlife with lakeside romance at Naivasha.
highlights: Private game drives in a Mara conservancy
Champagne bush dinner under the stars
Couples boat ride on Lake Naivasha
included: Luxury lodge and tented camp accommodation
Private game drives and balloon safari

itinerary.title: Arrival
itinerary.description: Welcome at Nairobi airport. Transfer to a boutique hotel for overnight rest.

itinerary.title: Maasai Mara Conservancy
itinerary.description: Fly to the Mara. Private game drives morning and evening. Champagne bush dinner on night two.

itinerary.title: Balloon & Transfer
itinerary.description: Sunrise balloon ride over the savanna. Fly to Lake Naivasha and check into your lakeside retreat.

itinerary.title: Lake Naivasha
itinerary.description: Private boat ride. Afternoon couples spa. Romantic farewell dinner.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Leisurely morning, then transfer to Nairobi.

title: 7 Days Lamu & Diani
description: Seven days of barefoot luxury along Kenya's Indian Ocean coast. Begin on the powdery white sands of Diani Beach with private villa stays and sunset dhow cruises, then fly to the ancient island of Lamu where donkey carts replace cars and centuries-old Swahili architecture lines the narrow streets. An unhurried coastal journey that pairs two of Kenya's most distinctive coastal destinations into a single week.
shortDescription: A 7-day coastal journey from Diani's white sands to Lamu's ancient island charm.
highlights: Lamu Old Town UNESCO walking tour
included: All-inclusive boutique Swahili hotel on Lamu
All meals, snacks, and house beverages at both stays
Sunset dhow cruise and Shela Beach picnic
notIncluded: International and domestic flights to Mombasa

itinerary.title: Arrive in Diani
itinerary.description: Transfer from Mombasa airport to your private beach villa. Welcome cocktails on the terrace.

itinerary.title: Diani Beach
itinerary.description: Two days of beach bliss. Sunset dhow cruise, snorkeling at the reef, couples spa afternoon.

itinerary.title: Fly to Lamu
itinerary.description: Morning flight to Lamu Island. Settle into your boutique Swahili hotel. Afternoon Old Town walking tour.

itinerary.title: Lamu Island
itinerary.description: Dhow sailing, Shela Beach picnic, visit local artisans. Rooftop dinner overlooking the waterfront.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure, then fly back to Nairobi or Mombasa.

title: Bush & Beach Honeymoon
description: The best of both worlds for couples who want wildlife and ocean. Start with three days of private game drives in Amboseli, where elephants walk in silhouette against Mount Kilimanjaro, then fly to Diani Beach for four days of white sand, warm water, and absolute relaxation. A honeymoon designed for couples who want to experience everything Kenya has to offer.
shortDescription: An 8-day honeymoon combining Amboseli safari with Diani Beach luxury.
highlights: Farewell sunset dinner on the beach
included: Luxury safari lodge accommodation in Amboseli
All meals and house beverages on the safari portion (full board)
All-inclusive beachfront villa at Diani — meals, snacks, drinks, and resort activities included
All park fees and ground transfers

itinerary.title: Arrive in Amboseli
itinerary.description: Fly from Nairobi to Amboseli. Afternoon game drive with Kilimanjaro views.

itinerary.title: Amboseli Safari
itinerary.description: Two full days of private game drives. Sundowner on Observation Hill. Visit a Maasai community.

itinerary.title: Fly to Diani
itinerary.description: Morning flight to the coast. Check into your beachfront villa. Afternoon at leisure.

itinerary.title: Diani Beach
itinerary.description: Three days of beach relaxation. Snorkeling, spa, and a sunset dinner on the sand.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning at the beach, then transfer to Mombasa airport.

title: SGR Coastal Explorer
description: Experience Kenya's modern Standard Gauge Railway on a scenic journey from Nairobi to the coast. The SGR train crosses the plains of Tsavo, offering glimpses of wildlife from the window as you travel in first-class comfort. Arrive in Mombasa for a day of Old Town exploration, then head south to Diani Beach for white sand and warm ocean. A unique way to see the country from a completely different perspective.
shortDescription: A 5-day train journey from Nairobi to the coast, combining the SGR experience with Diani Beach.
highlights: First-class SGR train from Nairobi to Mombasa
Wildlife spotting through Tsavo from the train
Mombasa Old Town and Fort Jesus visit
Fresh seafood dining on the coast
included: All-inclusive beach resort accommodation at Diani — meals, snacks, drinks, and resort activities included
All transfers between Mombasa and Diani
notIncluded: Lunches and dinners in Mombasa city

itinerary.title: SGR to Mombasa
itinerary.description: Board the morning SGR train at Nairobi Terminus. Five-hour scenic journey through Tsavo. Arrive in Mombasa and transfer to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Mombasa Old Town
itinerary.description: Guided tour of Fort Jesus, the Old Town's narrow streets, and the Likoni ferry crossing. Afternoon at leisure.

itinerary.title: Diani Beach
itinerary.description: Transfer south to Diani Beach. Two days of white sand, snorkeling, and coastal relaxation.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning on the beach. Transfer to Mombasa airport, or take the SGR back to Nairobi.

title: SGR Watamu Getaway
description: Combine the thrill of Kenya's SGR train with the marine paradise of Watamu. Travel in first-class comfort from Nairobi to Mombasa, then drive north along the coast to Watamu, where coral reefs, sea turtles, and pristine beaches await. A perfect blend of overland adventure and coastal discovery.
shortDescription: A 4-day SGR train trip from Nairobi to Mombasa, continuing to Watamu's marine paradise.
included: All-inclusive beach resort accommodation at Watamu — meals, snacks, drinks, and resort activities included
Snorkeling gear, marine park entry, and glass-bottom boat trip

itinerary.title: SGR to Mombasa
itinerary.description: Morning SGR train from Nairobi. Arrive Mombasa and drive north to Watamu. Settle into your beach resort.

itinerary.title: Marine Park
itinerary.description: Morning snorkeling in Watamu Marine National Park. Afternoon visit to the sea turtle conservation centre.

itinerary.title: Gede Ruins & Beach
itinerary.description: Explore the mysterious Gede Ruins. Afternoon glass-bottom boat ride over the reef. Evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning swim, then transfer to Mombasa for your SGR train or flight home.
